source.name: Scottish FA: New Scotland Home Kit Launched by adidas
source.quote: The latest adidas Football home kit for the Men's and Women's National Teams have been unveiled today
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers (same as croatia-2026-home, germany-2026-home). Launch date 2025-11-05; the shirt was still in use in October 2026, worn in Scotland's UEFA Nations League matches (Scottish FA match photography, 1 October 2026). Every placement checked in the launch imagery: the Scottish FA's flat product shot and Footy Headlines' studio gallery (footyheadlines.com, 2025-11-06: front, back, sleeve and shorts shots, model-worn and flat) show only the adidas performance logo and the Scotland crest on the chest, an embossed Saltire pattern across the body, a Saltire print under the back collar, plain sleeves with white cuff trim, and navy shorts carrying only the Scotland crest and adidas logo. No commercial sponsor on any placement. The shirt is sold without a front sponsor; the Scottish FA's partner list (Barclays, JD Sports, Scottish Gas etc.) are association partners, not shirt sponsors.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: the adidas home shirt unveiled by the Scottish FA on 5 November 2025 (dark navy with an embossed Saltire pattern, still worn in the side's UEFA Nations League matches in October 2026) carries only the adidas logo and the Scotland crest; the launch photos show plain sleeves, a plain back with an under-collar Saltire print, and navy shorts with only the crest and adidas marks (Scottish FA announcement and product imagery, Footy Headlines launch gallery).
